item.title: Ringier AG acquires Myanmar´s No 1 online job platform: MyJobs.com.mm
item.description: In cooperation with its local partner Information Matrix Co. Ltd., Ringier AG has entered into an agreement to acquire the online job platform MyJobs.com.mm. Through this acquisition Ringier underlines its Marketplaces' strategy as a key strategic pillar of the Group and the declared goal to become the unprecedented leader in digital businesses in the country.
